contentText: In tonight's edition, Senegal eagerly awaited the return of its champions on  Monday, with the population given a national holiday after the country's AFCON win over Morocco. Also, the Congolese army says it has regained control of the city of Uvira following the withdrawal of the M23 armed group. And heavy rains have flooded South Africa, Mozambique, and Zimbabwe, overwhelming rivers and infrastructure.
